game_title: Split Join Assembly – Avalanche Slope Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope, a slope primed for avalanche: the rescue climber must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Split Join Assembly: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders.
theme: Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope: a slope primed for avalanche
core_gameplay_loop: In Avalanche Slope, repeat each round: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders. Each round, a new ice axes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the assembly value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 100 points of ice axes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Split Join Assembly
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Split Join Assembly' (Week 8 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Avalanche Slope'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how assembly changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Avalanche Slope.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 46 seconds.
